description_en: Retrieve screen recording files from all regions
description_zh: 查询全地域录屏文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-record-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-7w78ozhjcwa3u0000 --end-user-id Alice --start-time 20251218175715 --end-time 20251218205715 --status 1 --record-type alltime --order-by startTime --order-sort asc --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --file-name Task7 --resource-type example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRecordFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions that are supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the screen recording file. Valid values:

- `0`: The file is uploaded.

- `1`: The file is being uploaded
parameters.help_zh:
录屏文件状态。
- 0 ：上传成功。
- 1 ：上传中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the screen recording. Valid values:

- `alltime`: full-time recording

- `period`: recording at intervals

- `event`: event-triggered recording

- `session`: session-based recording
parameters.help_zh:
录屏文件类型。
- alltime : 全程录屏。
- period : 间隔录屏。
- event ：时间录屏。
- session ： 会话录屏
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting basis. If you do not specify this parameter, the results are sorted by screen recording start time in descending order. Valid value:

- `startTime`: the start time of a screen recording
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，若不指定则按照录屏开始时间倒序。
- startTime ： 录屏开始时间
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- `asc`: ascending

- `desc`: descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。
- asc :  正序。
- desc : 倒序
parameters.name: order_sort

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页最大行数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the recording file
parameters.name: file_name
